name: Lissandra
title: the Ice Witch

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation

description.normalized: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra, they become a Frozen Thrall that seeks out living enemies. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies by 25% and shatter after 4 seconds, dealing 110 (+40% AP) magic damage.

passive.rawParsedText:
When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra, they become a Frozen Thrall that seeks out living enemies.

Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies by 25% and shatter after 4 seconds, dealing 110 (+40% AP) magic damage.

q.name: Ice Shard

description.normalized: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 (+70% AP) magic damage and slowing the target by 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies behind the target take the same damage and are also slowed.

w.name: Ring of Frost

description.normalized: Creates an ice field, rooting enemies within for 1.25 / 1.35 / 1.45 / 1.55 seconds and dealing 55 / 100 / 145 / 190 (+55% AP) magic damage.

w.rawParsedText: Creates an ice field, rooting enemies within for 1.25 / 1.35 / 1.45 / 1.55 seconds and dealing 55 / 100 / 145 / 190 (+55% AP) magic damage.

e.name: Glacial Path

description.normalized: First Cast: Casts forth an ice claw that deals 50 / 95 / 140 / 185 (+40% AP) magic damage when it hits enemies in its path. Can be recast while the ice claw is moving. Recast: Lissandra teleports to the ice claw, which then disappears.

r.name: Frozen Tomb

description.normalized: Summons dark ice on an enemy champion or herself. Dark ice emanates from the target for 3 seconds, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+75% AP) magic damage and slowing enemies it touches by 30% / 45% / 60%. Cast on enemies: Encases an enemy champion in dark ice, stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Self-Cast: Encases herself in dark ice, entering stasis for 2.5 seconds and restoring 100 / 150 / 200 (+40% AP) Health, increased by 0% - 100% based on her missing Health. Maximum healing is granted when her Health drops to 30% or lower. When auto-aiming, self-casts Frozen Tomb automatically.
